before: <para id="import-auto-id1546668"><term id="import-auto-id2189091">Motors</term> are the most common application of magnetic force on current-carrying wires. Motors have loops of wire in a magnetic field. When current is passed through the loops, the magnetic field exerts force on the loops, which rotates a shaft. Electrical energy is converted to mechanical work in the process. (See <link target-id="import-auto-id1615457"/>.)</para>
